description: Amtrak Rail Lines is a dataset listed in State of Maryland open data portal (opendata.maryland.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Maryland. The Rail Network is a database of the nation's railway system at the 1:100,000 scale or better. The data set covers the State of Maryland. Coverage: Maryland. Its tags are doit, comprehensive database, set covers, railway system, rail network. The table has 34 columns. The portal shows 2025-07-22 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-maryland-gov-portal.
